title: Verify mastery: Provide a unified operator control surface
goal: VC-201-099 (P1) claims mastery of: Expose actual workload, resource, provider, configuration, federation, and evidence state through consistent CLI/API views; drill-down explains blocked work and actions obey the same grants and preconditions as automation.. Its own narrative does not claim delivery: PARTIAL: the operator surface renders providers, GPU and the queue (idle and no-GPU cases included), and susi fix applies the safe doctor findings. Verified by `tests/tui_top.rs` (tui_top_renders_providers_gpu_and_queue, tui_top_idle_queue_and_no_gpu) and `tests/zc_susi_fix.rs` (zc_susi_fix_applies_safe_doctor_findings). Residual: consistent CLI/API views across workload, resource, provider, confi. Prove or refute it: add a nonzero test named vc_201_099_mastery_* that exercises the capability on its production path, and record exactly which part is missing when it cannot be proven. Coverage is not mastery: this closes only when the capability is verified, and a linked closed task is not evidence.
